charts.title: 51 Peg b: orbits around Helvetios
charts.description: The orbits of Helvetios's planets in this map from above, to scale, with 51 Peg b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Cont et al. (2026), A&A 710, A345, Tables 1 and 2 (tilt 49.8 +5.8/-5.7 degrees from the planet's own Doppler shift; eccentricity fixed to zero, 2-sigma limit 0.0063; a/R* is its 0.052 au over the star's recorded 847,269 km) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.23582): P 4.2307966 d
